author: NorthEast News Desk
body: The Glocester Police Department is investigating a series of vehicle break-ins reported early Monday morning, according to WJAR.

Police said the incidents occurred in the areas of Highland Lake, Spring Grove and Chestnut Hill. The department asked residents to check home-security cameras for suspicious activity that could help investigators identify vehicles or people connected to the break-ins.

Authorities did not announce an arrest or provide a description of a suspect in the initial report. Residents who find signs of damage or missing property should document what they see and contact police rather than disturbing possible evidence.

Anyone with information is asked to call the Glocester Police Department at 401-568-2533. Residents can also review footage from the early-morning hours and share relevant clips or observations with investigators.
NorthEast News will update this report if police announce an arrest, identify a suspect or release additional information about the affected neighborhoods.
dek: Police are asking residents in three Glocester areas to review home-security footage after vehicles were broken into early Monday.
headline: Glocester police investigate rash of vehicle break-ins
